python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess, re
ROOT = "/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature"
p = pathlib.Path("src/codegen/lower_inst/builtins/io/seek_hash_arch.rs")
for _ in range(10):
    out = subprocess.run(["python3", "scripts/check_asm_comments.py", str(p)], cwd=ROOT,
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    bad = [int(m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(r":(\d+): //", out)]
    if not bad:
        print("clean")
        break
    lines = p.read_text().split("\n")
    for ln in bad:
        line = lines[ln - 1]
        if "); " not in line:
            continue
        i = line.index("); ")
        head = line[: i + 2]
        tail = line[i + 2 :].lstrip()
        pad = max(1, 80 - len(head))
        lines[ln - 1] = head + " " * pad + tail
    p.write_text("\n".join(lines))
else:
    print("still dirty")
